popCulture.title: Prometheus Bound
popCulture.creator: Aeschylus
popCulture.description: Aeschylus’ Io names Inachus as her river-father — the Argive progenitor whose line opens the Danaid and Heraclid genealogies of later myth.

popCulture.title: Inachus
popCulture.description: River-god and first king of the Argolid — father of Io, eponym of the Inachus, stem of Argive royalty.
